description: Source code for the Vercel AI Gateway chat transformation module, which integrates with OpenAI's chat completions endpoint, providing configuration, request transformation, and model retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: VercelAIGatewayConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vercel AI Gateway, extending OpenAIGPTConfig, providing methods to get supported parameters, transform requests, handle errors, and retrieve available models.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Property returning the identifier for the custom LLM provider, here 'vercel_ai_gateway'.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns the list of supported OpenAI parameters, adding 'extra_body' as a special parameter.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL and API key, using secrets if not provided.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default and optional parameters for OpenAI requests, adding Vercel-specific options.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms the request data to match the API's expected format, delegating to the superclass implementation.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Creates and returns an exception instance for errors encountered during API calls.

methods.name: List[str] get_models( self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Fetches available models from the Vercel AI Gateway API.
